summary: Icon Energy Corp. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release with a routine commercial update on vessel chartering. The company disclosed that its panamax vessel Alfa's floating-rate charter was converted to a fixed rate of $18,000/day for June-December 2026, adding ~$3.7M to minimum contracted revenue. Two other vessels remain on index-linked charters. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC transaction, or abrupt management change is reported. This is an ordinary operational update, not a special situation.
